name: compat_purchase_conflicting_sources
user_messages:
Inbound message source: provider=internal conversation_id=cnv_task_compat role=user sender=Alice

I want to buy a replacement M.2 SSD thermal bracket (Part #5M11B95321) for my ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (21KC). One blog post says Gen 10/11 brackets don't fit Gen 12, while the seller says 5M11B95321 fits Gen 10/11/12. Can you verify and tell me whether I should buy it?

results.title: ThinkPad Upgrade Forum — SSD Bracket Warning
results.snippet: Warning: do not buy Gen 10/11 SSD brackets for ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12, many aftermarket brackets do not line up.

results.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (21KC) Hardware Maintenance Manual
results.snippet: 2280 M.2 NVMe slot uses an integrated thermal bracket; fitment depends on the mounting screw-hole tab offset (25mm vs 22mm) and standoff height.

results.title: Replacement SSD Bracket 5M11B95321 Seller Listing
results.snippet: Fits ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10 / Gen 11 / Gen 12. Exact tab offset and standoff dimensions are not published on this listing.

pages.title: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 HMM — M.2 Bracket
pages.content: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 (21KC) uses a 2280 M.2 thermal bracket whose compatibility is determined by the mounting tab screw-hole offset (25mm on 21KC vs 22mm on earlier revisions) and standoff height. Official parts lookup does not list aftermarket SKU 5M11B95321.

pages.title: Part 5M11B95321 Product Page
pages.content: Title claims compatibility with ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 10, Gen 11, and Gen 12. Specification table omits the mounting tab screw-hole offset and standoff height measurements; buyer photos show two different tab styles across batches.

required_output_patterns: (?i)(check|compare|verify|confirm|measure|ask the seller|核对|对比|确认|量|问卖家)
forbidden_output_patterns: (?i)(confirmed incompatible|definitely won't fit|definitely does not fit|肯定不兼容|绝对装不上)
